rules.title: Rules
rules.text: The code has four symbols drawn from six; a symbol can appear more than once. You have ten guesses. After each guess you see how many symbols are in the right place (“exact”) and how many are in the code but in a different place (“near”). Keyboard: 1 to 6 places a symbol, Backspace removes the last one, Enter submits the guess.
